fields.description: Absolute local workspace root with no trailing slash.
Workspace-relative helper directory containing resolved smoke.py and server_entry.py; output child must not already exist.
Workspace-relative assembled complete product source directory; not this six-file overlay alone.
SHA-256 of canonical JSON sorted direct-child [name,type] entries of the assembled candidate root, using the helper algorithm; verify the package inventory pin independently.
SHA-256 of resolved server_entry.py, after its absolute candidate path is bound.
Fresh capture ID declaring one shared sample-coordinate domain; 1-128 permitted ASCII identifier characters.
Workspace-relative prepared assets directory with pinned models and installation metadata.
Workspace-relative verified Python 3.12 runtime directory; installed package must match the source lock and fixed overrides.
Workspace-relative source lock file with the unchanged SHA-256 pin.
Workspace-relative authorized fixture WAV matching the unchanged 672044-byte/336000-frame digest pin.
Fresh idempotency key for the optional single MOSS request.
Absolute path equal to WORKSPACE_ROOT joined with CANDIDATE_DIRECTORY; only this assembled candidate root is inserted.

instruction: Resolve every placeholder locally before execution. Keep deployment values private. Preserve Python literal syntax. The relocated entry and root-layout SHA-256 values are required bindings, while package/runtime/source-lock/fixture pins stay unchanged.

retained_environment_input.name: AUDIO_API_KEY
retained_environment_input.purpose: Optional local API authentication supplied privately at runtime.

template_behavior: Actual helper control flow and limits preserved. Local paths, invocation identifiers, relocated entry/root-layout integrity values and entry description are substituted. Public templates are unexecuted.
